statement.p: For each of the following, perform the indicated operations on the vectors
\vec a = 3\,\mathit{\vec j}+3\,\mathit{\vec k}, \vec b = 5\,\mathit{\vec i}-5\,\mathit{\vec j}+\,\mathit{\vec k}, \vec z = 3\,\mathit{\vec i}+3\,\mathit{\vec j}.

static.solution:
(a) 5 \vec a + 3 \vec b = 5 (3\,\mathit{\vec j}+3\,\mathit{\vec k}) + 3 (5\,\mathit{\vec i}-5\,\mathit{\vec j}+\,\mathit{\vec k}) = 15\,\mathit{\vec i}+18\,\mathit{\vec k}.
(b) 6 \vec a + 5 \vec b - 2 \vec z = 6 (3\,\mathit{\vec j}+3\,\mathit{\vec k}) + 5 (5\,\mathit{\vec i}-5\,\mathit{\vec j}+\,\mathit{\vec k}) - 2 (3\,\mathit{\vec i}+3\,\mathit{\vec j}) = 19\,\mathit{\vec i}-13\,\mathit{\vec j}+23\,\mathit{\vec k}.
